name: 施設の料金ラベルを重ねる地図のマーカー群
prompt:
Create one isolated cluster of reusable Airbnb-style map price badges, centered on a pure-white square canvas with generous whitespace.

Reference priority:
1) The first image is a lossless crop of the actual NYC map screenshot. Use it to match the white capsule badges, rounded proportions, bold black price type, subtle gray edge and raised shadow, and the natural close overlap of map labels. The map is context only.
2) The second image is the Japanese native preview. It defines which eight complete badges belong in this isolated component, their yen formatting, and their irregular arrangement. It is secondary for badge styling.

Render exactly these eight labels, once each, with this exact spacing and punctuation:
¥ 30,600
¥ 35,600
¥ 52,300
¥ 45,000
¥ 28,500
¥ 47,900
¥ 38,600
¥ 18,800

Arrange them as a compact, irregular map cluster: two near the top on a vertical axis; a row of three through the middle; one slightly forward below that row; and two more stepping down toward the right. Keep the soft overlap between capsule edges, but leave every character and every complete price fully visible. Vary each capsule width just enough to fit its label. Keep badge height, capsule radius, text baseline, and shadow consistent.

Use white #FFFFFF capsules, near-black #1D1D1D price text, a very subtle cool-gray outline, and a restrained soft shadow under each badge. Use a Meiryo-style Japanese sans-serif, bold numeric price labels around 18–20 px with comfortable vertical centering. Keep the clean neutral Airbnb map-label feel; no green accent or selected badge is shown in the references.

Do not include the map, roads, city names, location dot, blank marker capsules, or partially hidden background prices. Add no card behind the cluster, titles, extra labels, icons, logos, or watermark. Produce one crisp static component with readable text and no clipped edges.
reviewNotes: エージェント確認済み候補。8件の価格は日本語プレビューと一致。参照元の白いカプセル形状、太字、重なり、影を保持。全価格の文字を読める。オーナー承認・実装は未確認。
reviewNotice: 画像生成候補。ネイティブ編集・実装・所有者承認とは別です。
